en.headline: Ceiling and concrete fall at Wong Tai Sin bakery, woman hurt
en.dek: A section of ceiling about four metres by three metres came down at a ground-floor bakery on Sheung Fung Street this morning, hitting a customer who was taken to hospital.
body: Part of the ceiling of a ground-floor bakery at 14 Sheung Fung Street in Wong Tai Sin collapsed at about 7.54 a.m. on Friday, sending concrete fragments onto the shop floor and striking a woman in her 20s, local media reported.

The woman suffered abrasions to her head and limbs and remained conscious. Ambulance crews took her to hospital. Photographs from the scene showed a large patch of ceiling hanging, slabs of concrete on the floor, and mooncake and bread packaging covered in debris.
Police cordoned off the shop. Officers from the Buildings Department attended to check whether the structure was stable. The cause of the collapse has not been announced.

zh.headline: 黃大仙麵包舖天花連石尾墮下 女顧客受傷送院
zh.dek: 雙鳳街一地下麵包舖今早約4米乘3米天花連同石尾剝落，擊中一名二十多歲女顧客，她清醒送院。
body: 黃大仙雙鳳街14號地下一間麵包舖，今日上午約7晈54分有約4米乘3米的天花連同部分石尾墮下，碎片擊中一名年約20多歲女顧客。
女顧客頭部及手腳擦傷，仍然清醒，由救護員送院治理。現場可見部分天花半天吊，地面布滿石尾碎，舖內麵包及月餅包裝亦沾上碎片。
警方圍封舖面，屋宇署人員到場檢查樓宇結構是否穩妤。墮下原因有待公布。
